name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx web tier with three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, static site content, TLS certificates, and host security controls including fail2ban, firewall, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, log directory creation, and cleanup of replication-related directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python, PostgreSQL, Git, a virtual environment, application dependencies, environment configuration, and a systemd service running Uvicorn.
